Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly concluded that George Murphy was the star of the film. The evidence presented in the previous step (the IMDb page) clearly listed "George Raft" as the lead actor playing "Johnny Angel". The Planner hallucinated the name "George Murphy" and falsely claimed the IMDb page confirmed George Raft as an American film actor and dancer, whereas the actual error was misidentifying the lead actor's name (confusing Raft with Murphy) and fabricating the biographical connection to the specific role.
